name: sidebar-01
title: Sidebar 01
description: An app shell with a sidebar of grouped links.

files.content:
import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/ui/avatar/avatar'; import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator, } from '@/ui/breadcrumb/breadcrumb'; import { Separator } from '@/ui/separator/separator'; import { Sidebar, SidebarContainer, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGap, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupContent, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarHeader, SidebarInner, SidebarInset, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarProvider, SidebarTrigger, } from '@/ui/sidebar/sidebar'; /** A link in one of the sidebar's groups. */ interface NavLink { readonly href: string; readonly label: string; readonly icon: string; } /** A labelled group of sidebar links, rendered as its own `nav`. */ interface NavGroup { readonly id: string; readonly label: string; readonly links: readonly NavLink[]; } /** * An app shell: a sidebar with the team, two groups of links (each its own * named `nav`) and the signed-in user, beside the page's `main` with a * header bar, a breadcrumb and placeholder content. The sidebar slides * off-canvas with its trigger or Ctrl+B (⌘B), and opens as a modal sheet * below the `md` breakpoint. */ @Component({ selector: 'block-sidebar-01', imports: [ Avatar, AvatarFallback, Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator, NdIcon, Separator, Sidebar, SidebarContainer, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGap, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupContent, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarHeader, SidebarInner, SidebarInset, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarProvider, SidebarTrigger, ], template: `
Ndop Studio Enterprise
@for (group of groups; track group.id) {
{{ group.label }}
    @for (link of group.links; track link.href) {
  • {{ link.label }}
    • }
}
AN Amina Njoya amina@example.com
  1. Platform
  3. Dashboard

Dashboard

@for (tile of tiles; track tile) {
}
`, }) export class Sidebar01Block { /** The link to the page this shell shows, marked as current. */ protected readonly current = '/dashboard'; protected readonly groups: readonly NavGroup[] = [ { id: 'sidebar-01-platform', label: 'Platform', links: [ { href: '/dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', icon: 'layout-dashboard' }, { href: '/projects', label: 'Projects', icon: 'folder' }, { href: '/team', label: 'Team', icon: 'users' }, { href: '/inbox', label: 'Inbox', icon: 'inbox' }, ], }, { id: 'sidebar-01-resources', label: 'Resources', links: [ { href: '/docs', label: 'Documentation', icon: 'file-text' }, { href: '/support', label: 'Support', icon: 'life-buoy' }, { href: '/settings', label: 'Settings', icon: 'settings' }, ], }, ]; protected readonly tiles = [1, 2, 3]; }

docs: Route to it, for example: { path: 'sidebar-01', loadComponent: () => import('./blocks/sidebar-01/sidebar-01').then((m) => m.Sidebar01Block) }
